name: Escape ~Akizora no Roof Garden~
original_name: エスケープ ～秋空のルーフガーデン～
source:
October, before the school festival. Main character painfully recovers from his lover's death. At school rooftop he decides to move on and pay attention to school girls.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-september-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
十月，学园祭前夕。主角从爱人的死中痛苦地恢复过来。在学校屋顶，他决定继续前进并关注女学生。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-september-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
